# PHAROS

> PHAROS (Greek "Φάρος", lighthouse) is a self-hosted personal hub: one private dashboard for the things you own and pay for. It reads your receipts and statements with AI, tracks inventory, expenses, credit-card installments, subscriptions and vouchers, gives you reports, and can watch your home network. Tagline: "One light over everything you run." Backronym: PH (Personal Hub) + AROS (Asset & Resource Oversight System).

PHAROS ships two ways. Self-hosted is free and open source under AGPL-3.0: run it on your own hardware with Docker, and your data never leaves your machine. A managed hosted service (currently in private beta / waitlist) runs the same hub for you, with automatic backups, updates and included AI parsing.

Design principles: local-first, privacy-first (financial data stays under your control), no telemetry, dark-theme dashboard, mobile-friendly. Bring your own AI provider when self-hosting (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints).

## Modules

- [Inventory & shopping](https://ph-aros.com/#features): Track what you own and what you plan to buy, with price history across stores and target-price alerts.
- [Receipts with AI](https://ph-aros.com/#ai): Drop in a photo or PDF; AI reads store, date, total, VAT and line items, in many languages. OCR handles scanned and rotated receipts.
- [Expenses & income](https://ph-aros.com/#features): Log bills and income, scan documents, auto-detect recurring series and spending anomalies.
- [Statements & installments](https://ph-aros.com/#features): Import credit-card statement PDFs, reconstruct installment plans, and see what you owe month by month.
- [Subscriptions](https://ph-aros.com/#features): Track recurring charges with a renewal calendar.
- [Vouchers](https://ph-aros.com/#features): Store discount codes and gift vouchers with expiry reminders.
- [Reports](https://ph-aros.com/#features): Net position, cash flow, budgets, spend by category and store.
- [Network](https://ph-aros.com/#features): Optional UniFi dashboard for devices, clients, WAN health and speed tests.

## Pricing

- [Self-hosted · Free forever](https://ph-aros.com/#pricing): Every module, no limits, AGPL-3.0, community support. Run it yourself with Docker.
- [Solo · €4/month](https://ph-aros.com/#pricing): Managed hosting for one user, every module, AI parsing included, nightly backups. (Hosted beta, waitlist.)
- [Family · €8/month](https://ph-aros.com/#pricing): Shared household hub for up to 5 members, higher AI limits, priority email support. (Hosted beta, waitlist.)
- [Pro · €15/month](https://ph-aros.com/#pricing): Everything in Family plus REST API access and highest AI limits. (Hosted beta, waitlist.)

Every hosted plan can be billed monthly or annually. Annual billing charges ten months up front, so two months are free per year (Solo €40/year, Family €80/year, Pro €150/year). Every hosted plan includes AI parsing and nightly backups, and you can cancel anytime.

Hosted prices are indicative during the beta and may change before general availability.

## Getting started

- [Self-host with Docker](https://ph-aros.com/#self-host): Bring up the hub, MongoDB and search with a single Docker Compose file.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/achilleasgkekas/pharos): Source code, README and issues.
- [Documentation (README)](https://github.com/achilleasgkekas/pharos/blob/main/README.md): Setup and configuration.
- [Hosted beta waitlist](https://ph-aros.com/#waitlist): Join to be notified when managed hosting opens.
